```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}

jobs:
  setup-copilot:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Dart SDK
        uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - name: Install Flutter SDK
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.19.0'
          channel: 'stable'

      - name: Setup Dart Workspace
        run: |
          # Create root pubspec.yaml with workspace configuration
          cat > pubspec.yaml << EOF
          name: marionette_mcp_workspace
          version: 0.0.1
          publish_to: none
          
          workspace:
            - packages/*
            - apps/*
          EOF
          
          # Add resolution: workspace to all package pubspecs
          find . -name "pubspec.yaml" -not -path "./pubspec.yaml" | while read -r file; do
            if ! grep -q "resolution:" "$file"; then
              sed -i '/^name:/a\  resolution: workspace' "$file"
            fi
          done

      - name: Run dart pub get
        run: dart pub get
```
